title: Svelte Small Examples
description: Use these small Svelte examples with the tools described in each lesson. Read the expected result before you try a change.

examples.title: Show a value
examples.description: A Svelte component can contain a script and page markup.
examples.output: The component shows Reading club as its heading.

examples.title: Use state that changes
examples.description: The $state rune creates a value Svelte tracks.
examples.output: Each click adds one to the visible book count.

examples.title: Derive a new value
examples.description: The $derived rune describes a value calculated from other state.
examples.output: The page starts at 20 pages and increases by ten with each click.

examples.title: Show one of two messages
examples.description: An if block includes content only when its condition is true.
examples.code:
{#if ready}

Ready to read

{:else}

Choose a book

{/if}
examples.output: The button switches between the two messages.

examples.title: Make a keyed list
examples.description: An each block repeats markup for a list.
examples.code:
{#each books as book (book.id)}
  • {book.title}
    • {/each}
examples.output: The two titles appear as list items with stable book ids.

examples.title: Bind typed text
examples.description: bind:value links an input to a state value.
examples.output: The greeting changes as the person types.

examples.title: Read a prop
examples.description: A prop is a value given to a component by its parent.
examples.code: {title}
examples.output: The BookCard child shows Moon Trip. The default title is used if the parent omits it.

examples.title: Call a parent callback
examples.description: A callback prop lets a child ask its parent to react.
examples.code:
title=value}/>

{title}
examples.output: The child button calls the parent callback, and the parent displays the title.

examples.title: Share a snippet of content
examples.description: A snippet is a reusable piece of Svelte markup.
examples.code:
Note

{@render children?.()}

Bring a notebook.
examples.output: The supplied paragraph appears inside the note wrapper.

examples.title: Run and clean up an effect
examples.description: An effect runs after Svelte updates the page and tracks reactive values it reads.
examples.output: The timer increments the state. Cleanup stops that timer when the component is removed.

examples.title: Style one component
examples.description: Svelte scopes ordinary component styles so they mainly affect markup from that component.
examples.output: The component heading is navy and its paragraph has roomy line spacing.

examples.title: Add items with a form
examples.description: A form can add trimmed text to a reactive list.
examples.code:
{#each books as book (book.id)}
  • {book.title}
    • {/each}
examples.output: Each non-empty submitted title becomes a list item. The form clears after adding it.
